about_the_game: The melancholic and emotional melodies that deepen the world of Luctus are now available as a standalone package. Composed by three different musicians and composers, these pieces capture the feelings of a character walking in the shadow of loss and add a powerful emotional layer to the game’s atmosphere. They make the quiet moments even heavier and the battles even more unforgettable, allowing you to carry the soul of Luctus with you beyond the game itself.
